# Migration agent

Read `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant workflow, older migrations, and database contracts. Capture `git status --short` and `git diff`; run `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` before edits. Prefer additive reversible migrations and never run migrate-down without approval. After edits, rerun the canonical check and relevant commands.
